warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLK220 CDI/d Injector Seal & Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your GLK220 CDI/d has the OM651 2.1-litre diesel - that's the X204 generation, produced from 2008 to 2015 - injector seal leaks and timing chain/tensioner wear are well-documented patterns on this engine, shared across the C-Class family and backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace the timing chain, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.
